authorship: Independently authored bounded expectations, not extracted from generated answers or from the observation fixtures. Catalogue identifiers reuse the checked-in C3 catalogue; these are evaluation cases, not expert-certified reference architectures.

none.description: No additional cardinality requirement in this authored case.

channel-choice.description: Exactly one channel is required by this case, not by relation legality.

rules.requiredEvidence: Complete accepted channel selection for the authored requirement

input-feed.description: One input is needed, but its identity must remain open when unspecified.

rules.requiredEvidence: Identified source and complete accepted input relations

cases.requirement: Read published environmental observations in the hydrographic application. This requirement does not authorize creating observations.

clauses.C1: Read published environmental observations in the hydrographic application.
clauses.C2: This requirement does not authorize creating observations.

cases.rationale: A directed CONSUMES relation represents reading. An inverse or PRODUCES relation is an unjustified assertion in this bounded case.

cases.requirement: The information dissemination process shall use exactly one selected notification channel: text-based communication or informal email messaging. Either choice is acceptable; do not require both.

clauses.C1: The information dissemination process shall use exactly one selected notification channel: text-based communication or informal email messaging.
clauses.C2: Either choice is acceptable; do not require both.

cases.rationale: The obligation counts one channel across the union of the two independently permitted targets; neither particular target is individually mandatory.

cases.requirement: The hydrographic application shall read observations from a source that has not yet been identified. Keep the source identity open until the owner provides it.

clauses.C1: The hydrographic application shall read observations from a source that has not yet been identified.
clauses.C2: Keep the source identity open until the owner provides it.

cases.rationale: Missing source evidence is an open question, not proof of a missing required edge and not permission to assert a particular product identity.

cases.requirement: The dissemination process must delete delivery history immediately. The same delivery history must be retained for thirty days. Identify this conflict without selecting one policy as accepted.

clauses.C1: The dissemination process must delete delivery history immediately.
clauses.C2: The same delivery history must be retained for thirty days.
clauses.C3: Identify this conflict without selecting one policy as accepted.

cases.rationale: The conflicting retention clauses cannot both be adopted. Preserve an unresolved property and a question bound to both clauses.

questions.text: Which retention clause should be revised by the owner?

cases.requirement: Rename the existing hydrographic application to Flood observation viewer. Preserve its identity, source label and observation input; create no replacement application.

clauses.C1: Rename the existing hydrographic application to Flood observation viewer.
clauses.C2: Preserve its identity, source label and observation input; create no replacement application.

cases.rationale: An update changes the named property on the same model object. A copied replacement, deleted input or lost retained property is an error.

cases.requirement: The existing hydrographic application already reads the published observation product. Confirm the existing read-only arrangement; add no application, service or relation.

clauses.C1: The existing hydrographic application already reads the published observation product.
clauses.C2: Confirm the existing read-only arrangement; add no application, service or relation.

cases.rationale: No new model element is needed. An unnecessary service or edge is observable over-modelling even if required relation recall remains perfect.
